title: 5.3.2 Apple Catcher — Worked Example
description: Catch falling apples with a basket. Learn overlap detection and per-frame spawning.

steps.title: Read the example
steps.instructions: A basket (arrow keys) at the bottom, an apples Group that spawns at the top. Overlap adds score.
hints: The basket is kinematic — moves with keys, not gravity.

steps.title: Speed up difficulty
steps.instructions: Make spawn rate increase over time — e.g., every 5 seconds drop the spawn interval.
hints: Use frameCount % spawnInterval === 0, then decrement spawnInterval periodically.

steps.title: Add rocks
steps.instructions: A second Group (rocks). Overlapping a rock costs a life.
hints: Give rocks a gray color and slightly slower fall.

steps.title: Display score
steps.instructions: In draw(), use text(score, 20, 30) to show the number.
hints: fill() or textColor() controls text color; textSize(24) sets the size.
